title: style: apply ruff formatting to test files
body:
## What
Applies `ruff-format` to test files to fix whitespace and line continuation formatting, moving assert statements to correctly formatted blocks.

## Why
To maintain code quality and ensure adherence to repository formatting standards as part of the daily automated QA review.

## Testing
All 364 tests pass successfully via `uv run pytest tests/`.
